# Govee Damage Flash

Govee Damage Flash is a client-side Fabric mod that connects Minecraft damage events to Govee LAN Control lights.

When you take damage, your selected Govee lights flash in your configured color. When you are not taking damage, the mod can keep your lights in an idle rainbow effect and refresh the color every few seconds so the lights stay synced.

## Features

- Flash Govee LAN lights when the player takes damage
- Optional triggers for low health and death
- Idle rainbow effect when not taking damage
- Automatic LAN discovery for supported Govee devices
- Manual IP setup if discovery does not work
- Per-device color, duration, and trigger config through the config file
- Language command with English, Swedish, German, French, Japanese, Russian, Chinese, and Finnish
- Works fully client-side

## Supported Setup

This mod uses Govee LAN Control over your local network.

Tested/targeted devices include:

- Govee Glide Tri
- Govee Neon Rope Light 2

Other Govee LAN Control devices may also work if they support the same local color commands.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1 - 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Java 21
- Govee LAN Control enabled in the Govee Home app

## Setup

1. Enable LAN Control for your Govee lights in the Govee Home app.
2. Make sure your PC and lights are on the same local network.
3. Install the mod and Fabric API in your `mods` folder.
4. Start Minecraft and run:

```text
/setup scan
